SELECT FROM ( SELECT record.attendance_date AS business_date, employee.dept_id AS department, department.dept_name AS department_name, employee.id AS employee, employee.name AS employee_name, record.status, record.id AS record_count, record.late_minutes, record.early_exit_minutes AS early_minutes, record.overtime_minutes, 0 AS integrity_error FROM hr_attendance_record record INNER JOIN hr_employee employee ON employee.id = record.employee_id AND employee.tenant_id = record.tenant_id AND employee.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_dept department ON department.dept_id = employee.dept_id AND department.tenant_id = employee.tenant_id WHERE record.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND record.deleted = 0 AND record.attendance_date BETWEEN #{query.startDate} AND #{query.endDate}
) fact

WITH RECURSIVE authorized_ledger AS ( SELECT ledger.*, employee.name AS employee_name, leave_type.leave_name AS leave_type_name, period.period_name FROM hr_leave_ledger ledger INNER JOIN hr_employee employee ON employee.id = ledger.employee_id AND employee.tenant_id = ledger.tenant_id AND employee.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN hr_leave_type leave_type ON leave_type.id = ledger.leave_type_id AND leave_type.tenant_id = ledger.tenant_id LEFT JOIN hr_leave_period period ON period.period_id = ledger.leave_period_id AND period.tenant_id = ledger.tenant_id WHERE ledger.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
), ledger_chain AS ( SELECT ledger.tenant_id, ledger.ledger_id AS origin_id, ledger.ledger_id AS current_id, ledger.employee_id, ledger.leave_type_id, ledger.leave_period_id, ledger.quantity_unit, ledger.reversal_of_id, ledger.transaction_type, JSON_ARRAY(ledger.ledger_id) AS visited, 0 AS cycle FROM authorized_ledger ledger UNION ALL SELECT parent.tenant_id, chain.origin_id, parent.ledger_id, parent.employee_id, parent.leave_type_id, parent.leave_period_id, parent.quantity_unit, parent.reversal_of_id, parent.transaction_type, JSON_ARRAY_APPEND(chain.visited, '$', parent.ledger_id), JSON_CONTAINS(chain.visited, JSON_ARRAY(parent.ledger_id)) FROM ledger_chain chain INNER JOIN authorized_ledger parent ON parent.ledger_id = chain.reversal_of_id AND parent.tenant_id = chain.tenant_id AND parent.employee_id = chain.employee_id AND parent.leave_type_id = chain.leave_type_id AND (parent.leave_period_id = chain.leave_period_id OR parent.leave_period_id IS NULL AND chain.leave_period_id IS NULL) AND parent.quantity_unit = chain.quantity_unit WHERE chain.reversal_of_id IS NOT NULL AND chain.cycle = 0 ) SELECT FROM ( SELECT origin.employee_id AS employee, origin.employee_name, origin.leave_type_id AS leave_type, origin.leave_type_name, origin.quantity_unit AS unit, origin.leave_period_id AS period, origin.period_name, CASE WHEN terminal.transaction_type IN ('ALLOCATION', 'CARRY_FORWARD', 'COMPENSATORY', 'ADJUSTMENT') THEN origin.leave_days ELSE 0 END AS total_quota, CASE WHEN terminal.transaction_type IN ('APPLICATION', 'EXPIRY', 'ENCASHMENT') THEN -origin.leave_days ELSE 0 END AS used_quota, CASE WHEN terminal.transaction_type IN ('FREEZE', 'UNFREEZE') THEN -origin.leave_days ELSE 0 END AS frozen_quota, origin.leave_days AS available_quota, (terminal.cycle <> 0 OR terminal.reversal_of_id IS NOT NULL OR terminal.transaction_type NOT IN ('ALLOCATION', 'CARRY_FORWARD', 'COMPENSATORY', 'ADJUSTMENT', 'APPLICATION', 'EXPIRY', 'ENCASHMENT', 'FREEZE', 'UNFREEZE') OR origin.quantity_unit NOT IN ('DAY', 'HOUR')) AS integrity_error FROM authorized_ledger origin INNER JOIN ledger_chain terminal ON terminal.origin_id = origin.ledger_id AND terminal.tenant_id = origin.tenant_id WHERE terminal.reversal_of_id IS NULL OR terminal.cycle <> 0 OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM authorized_ledger parent WHERE parent.ledger_id = terminal.reversal_of_id AND parent.tenant_id = terminal.tenant_id AND parent.employee_id = terminal.employee_id AND parent.leave_type_id = terminal.leave_type_id AND (parent.leave_period_id = terminal.leave_period_id OR parent.leave_period_id IS NULL AND terminal.leave_period_id IS NULL) AND parent.quantity_unit = terminal.quantity_unit ) ) fact
